title: PLASTIC CRAFT
description: A unique expansion that introduces versatile plastic materials, custom building blocks, and tools to upgrade your Minecraft survival experience.
body:
# 🛠️ Welcome to Plastic Craft!

Tired of the same old Minecraft materials? This mod expands your survival world by introducing a brand-new tier of resources, utility blocks, and decorative elements based on modern plastic manufacturing!

### 🚀 Key Features:
* **New Materials:** Craft and refine plastic pellets and sheets from raw components.
* **Modern Blocks:** Build industrial bases and modern houses with clean-looking, highly resistant plastic blocks.
* **Advanced Tools & Armor:** Equip a whole new tier of gear designed to withstand heavy survival encounters.
* **Vanilla Friendly:** Perfectly balanced to fit alongside your classic iron and diamond progression tiers.

### 📦 Why download this mod?
Plastic Craft provides builders and technical players with fresh block palettes and smooth textures that look great in any modern or industrial setup!

# ❌ There's no armor, just pickaxes! 

⚠️ **ATTENTION:** This mod is **100% dedicated to heavy-duty mining tools**. There are absolutely **NO armor sets, swords, or weapons** in this project! 

The entire ecosystem of **PLASTIC CRAFT** was engineered exclusively for fast, high-tech, polymer-reinforced **PICKAXES with plastic handles**. 

_If you came here to fight monsters, you're in the wrong place. If you came to destroy underground caverns at lightning speed, update your .jar file now!_
